title: HelperSessionDetachParams
description: Params of the helper session service's detach op: drop this attachment. The process survives it, and the session stays in the inventory and reattachable. Detach is NOT close-session and neither is closing a tab: in level 1 closing a tab is this verb plus losing the local tab, and the tab's rows are kept, so the blocks stay in recall. It names the attachment and nothing else — the subscriber's cursor and the host session both outlive it.
